title: Mixed Event — Get Fit & Fly! Muscle Training! — Episode5 Begin!

meta.Event Outline: Haruka thinks of ways to make exercise fun for MORE MORE JUMP!'s fans. By chance, she meets Tsukasa, who invites her to the athletic event Shinobi Battle!

rows.Line: The day of Shinobi Battle
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Well now.
So these are the SHINOBI stages...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I didn't realize they were this big.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's definitely different than just seeing them on a screen. But we've worked so hard for this day. I know we'll be okay.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree!
Not only that...

rows.Speaker: University Competitors
rows.Line: Alright, teamwork on three!

rows.Speaker: Amateur Competitors
rows.Line: We're gonna win today, no matter what!

rows.Speaker: Veteran Competitors
rows.Line:
SHINOBI is all that matters to us.
We will get the best time!

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: <More and more competitors are making their entrance! Which team is going to win today's Shinobi Battle?!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
The other teams seem just as motivated.
We can't let our guard down.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I heard that there'd be ten teams in total. A lot of them look like working adults and university students...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, and as we expected, they all look like they're in top physical condition. This won't be an easy battle...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, it won't be...
But luck may be on our side, since we're the second to last team to go.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right. We'll be able to adjust our tactics based on how the other teams do.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Agreed. We'll need to stay focused and keep a close eye on everyone while we wait for our turn to come around!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (This is it...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Everyone wished me good luck when I did that quick stream to let everybody know that we were here.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (All that's left is for us to go out there and get results...)

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <I'm not very athletic, but I wanna learn to do it like you, Haruka.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But... When things are looking really down, seeing your hero do her best can be just the motivation you need to keep on trying.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I have to do my best to spread as much hope as I can to our fans.)
Aha! There you are!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Huh...?
That sounded like...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haruka!
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: An?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: To cheer on my best friend, duh!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I just met with Minori and the others a second ago, and you won't believe how many comments you've been getting. A ton of people are wishing you good luck.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Do your best, Haruka!
Everybody's rooting for you like crazy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For the sake of everyone giving me their support, I promise to do my absolute best.

rows.Speaker: Announcement
rows.Line:
<To all spectators.
Shinobi Battle will begin momentarily.>

rows.Speaker: Announcement
rows.Line: <Competitors, please start getting ready.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, gotta get back to my seat.
See you later.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks for coming.
Please make sure to watch until the end.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Of course I will.
I'm expecting you to blow us all away, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line:
<Thank you all for your patience!
The time has finally arrived!>

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line: <The first group of Shinobi Battle competitors will be starting now!>

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Do your best!
Give us a good show!

rows.Speaker: First-Group Competitor
rows.Line:
Alright!
Let's do this!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(The first stage begins with the log bridge.
Your balance and control over your center of gravity need to be perfect in order to cross it.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(This person's fast...
But their upper body's sort of all over the place. As a result, they're having trouble maintaining their balance. Still...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A little rough, but they still managed to cross.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The log doesn't seem to roll or tilt as much as we were expecting. Even if something were to happen, you should be able to cross it fine as long as you're able to regain your balance.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Next are the spider walls...

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line:
<Oh no!
Our competitor from the first group has unfortunately fallen!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It took all his energy just to cling to the walls. He couldn't manage to actually move forward.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Your arms and legs need to be very strong in order to support the rest of your body as you cross.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(The log bridge is one thing...
But the spider walls look so tricky.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Still, Tenma did all that running, and became strong enough to do those chin-ups while wearing weights. He should be able to conquer this stage!)

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line:
<There we are!
Our competitor from group two has conquered the spider walls!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Next up is your stage, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Shinonome's stage begins with the high vault. Unlike the obstacles over the water, you fail if you decide to give up or don't clear it within the time limit.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (He should do fine given his jumping ability, which means the problem is the water spider...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Like the water spider and log bridge, it tests your core muscles. In addition, the pool surface itself adds an extra layer of uncertainty.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But Shinonome's balance is pretty solid. His core should be more than strong enough to take on this challenge after all the practice he's done this past week.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (So, I'm sure he'll succeed!)

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line: <Our eighth group has completed the final stage! That makes them the second to conquer the entire course!>

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line: <And their time is... Two minutes on the dot! That puts them in the lead!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Two minutes...
That's pretty fast.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It is. That means each of us only has about forty seconds to complete each stage.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which isn't going to be easy...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we just gotta do it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Agreed. You and I have to get the baton to Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, just wait and maintain your faith in us!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Tenma, Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, I believe in both of you!

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: We need the ninth group on standby!

rows.Speaker: Akito, Haruka & Tsukasa
rows.Line: Coming!

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line:
<This is it. The first stage...
Ready... Start!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You can do it, Tenma!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (The first stage is sort of a long way from where the third-stage competitors are supposed to wait. Thankfully, the monitors will show me what's happening...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (How's Tenma doing...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Roar*
se_event_muscle_2024_001

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Whoa, that guy's awesome!
He's going so fast!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Yes, and his balance is excellent...
He might finish this stage in record time!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Okay, he's off to a good start.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But the spider walls are going to take up a lot of time no matter what. He needs to spend as little time as possible on this part.)
se_event_muscle_2024_001

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! I'm almost... Huh?!
se_event_muscle_2024_002
se_event_muscle_2024_001

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (His foot slipped...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line:
<Oh no! He was doing so well!
But he fell into the pool after his foot slipped!
Unfortunately, that means he's...>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: No! I'm still here! I haven't fallen!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
...!
He's clinging to the bottom of the log...

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line: <Oh, he hasn't fallen in! That means he's still allowed to continue!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, he didn't fall in, but he's upside down... Can he even move?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line:
This is nothing!!
I put myself through that monstrous training schedule to make sure that I could recover from this sort of situation!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Roar*

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Cool!
He's shimmying forward while hanging from the log!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
His arms must be so strong!
He might just get to the end!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Go, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line:
<Oh, he's really moving now!
And there we are! He's crossed the log bridge!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: He did it...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Nice save!!

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line:
<Next, we have the spider walls!
It's a test of strength and explosiveness, but how will he fare here?!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Stick to the walls using your hands and feet. Walk like a real-life spider...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Roar*
Just watch! I've battled against monkeys and survived everything that Mikazukigumi threw at me!
se_event_muscle_2024_001

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line: <W-Wait! His hands and feet are a complete blur! He's moving so fast!>

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line: <He's trying to make up for the time he just lost!!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Whoa...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (He won't quite make it under forty seconds, but that's a remarkable time considering he almost fell in!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We just might...)
se_run_men_003_1
se_event_muscle_2024_003

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huff...! Huff...!
Go, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Let's do this!
